sources.title: Bamboo Rafting in Guilin: Prices, Routes & Best Times
sources.content:
Bamboo Rafting in Guilin: Complete Guide

Best Times for Bamboo Rafting
"April to October (excluding May) is Guilin's high-water season, recommended for both bamboo rafting and whitewater drifting activities." April and September-October offer pleasant weather with fewer crowds. July and August are less ideal due to intense heat and crowded rivers.

Top Yulong River Routes

Shui'edi to Gongnong Bridge (Most Popular)
- Duration: 40-50 minutes over 3km
- Price: $28 per raft (fits 2 people)
- This route provides excellent value and karst mountain views without requiring excessive time commitment

Jinlong Bridge to Jiuxian (Most Thrilling)
- Duration: ~90 minutes over 6km
- Price: $45 per raft (fits 2 people)
- Features 9 dams with largest drops; popular with younger adventurers but unsuitable for seniors

Jima to Gongnong Bridge (Quieter Option)
- Duration: ~90 minutes over 6km
- Price: $45 per raft (fits 2 people)
- Offers peaceful experience with gentler 9 dams; ideal for senior travelers

Lansheng Bridge to Camels Crossing (Family-Friendly)
- Duration: 40 minutes over 3.6km
- Price: $42 per raft (fits 3 people, round trip)
- Features 3 gentle dams and iconic landscape reflections

Wanjing Wharf Leisure Float (Most Budget-Friendly)
- Duration: 90 minutes over 2km
- Price: $7 per person on shared 8-person rafts
- Only option for children under 1 meter or seniors over 70

Li River Rafting
"The Xingping Pier to Nine Horses Fresco Hill route" offers motorized rafting with "stunning views and snap photos at the iconic 20 Yuan bill backdrop spot." Duration: 50 minutes, $17 per raft (4-person capacity).

Important Practical Tips
Participants exceeding 220 pounds should verify eligibility beforehand. Avoid drifting in May due to heavy rainfall. Bring spare clothes as getting wet is inevitable. Secure eyeglasses with rubber bands. Apply sun protection throughout. Note: Children under 1.4 meters and individuals over 55 cannot participate in whitewater drifting.

sources.title: Yangshuo Yulong River: More Than Just Bamboo Rafting
sources.content:
Yangshuo Yulong River: Complete Text Content

Introduction
The Yulong River sits approximately 8 kilometers from Yangshuo town and 70 kilometers from Guilin city center. Known for its gentle currents, bamboo raft experiences provide intimate views of karst mountains and riverside rural communities.

Bamboo Rafting Routes
Multiple docks along the river offer rafting experiences with similar scenery—stunning karst landscapes and pastoral views. Duration options include 40 minutes, 1.5 hours, or 2 hours. The 1.5-hour route is frequently recommended as it "provides ample time for photos and sightseeing without causing visual fatigue."

Ticket Information:
- Regular season: Book online via WeChat mini-program or at docks
- Peak seasons (Chinese New Year, May Day, National Day, July-August): Immediate sellouts with 1-2 hour wait times expected
- Alternative: Stand-up paddleboarding avoids crowd issues

Golden Dragon Parade
During major holidays and summer weekends, the Yulong River hosts an iconic celebration. Dozens of illuminated bamboo rafts form a shimmering golden dragon gliding along the river, accompanied by fireworks and cultural demonstrations lasting approximately 50 minutes.
Viewing Options:
- Yulong Bridge: Full parade view (~$15, limited to 80-100 tickets)
- Private raft: Close perspective ($50-$200 depending on position)

Stand-Up Paddleboarding (SUP)
SUP on quieter upper reaches offers flexibility for all skill levels. The ideal timeframe is "June through September when the warm weather makes water activities especially enjoyable."

Cycling and Hiking
Flat, well-maintained paths enable leisurely exploration of golden rice fields, ancient villages, and grazing water buffalo alongside karst mountains.
Main Route: Yulong Bridge -> Jiuxian -> Xiatangzhai -> Yangshuo Mountain Retreat
- Distance: 13 kilometers
- Cycling: ~1.5 hours
- Hiking: 4-5 hours
- Best season: Late September through mid-November

Cave Exploration
Yulong Cave, located 14 kilometers from Yangshuo, offers underground experiences including SUP on pristine subterranean lakes and stalactite formations.

Transportation and Dining
Travel from Yangshuo West Street requires approximately 30 minutes by car covering 7 kilometers. Peak season traffic can extend this significantly.
Local restaurants serve bamboo-tube chicken, beer fish, and stuffed river snails.

sources.title: How to Experience Bamboo Rafting on the Yulong River in Yangshuo (2026)
sources.content:
How to Experience Bamboo Rafting on the Yulong River in Yangshuo (2026)

You can pick from several bamboo rafting routes along the Yulong River, with some short and gentle routes perfect for families, and others longer with more dams, great for adventure seekers. The Shui'edi Wharf to Gongnong Bridge Wharf route is recommended, having fewer and gentler dams with a middle-duration ride that leaves time for other activities.

Simple and easy-to-dry clothing is better for bamboo rafting, and it's recommended to bring spare clothes and plastic slippers. When going down the rapids, you have to lift your feet so your shoes don't get wet, as you might get a bit wet.

Normally, bamboo rafting reservations are open 1 day in advance only, so you can try buying tickets at the wharf at 7:30 AM on your visit day, though hot routes sell out within minutes during peak season.

Unlike the grand Li River, the Yulong River presents a more intimate and delicate beauty with crystal-clear waters revealing the riverbed stones and swimming fish below, while the gentle current creates a peaceful atmosphere.

Autumn is the top choice, with September and October bringing pleasant days and cool nights. The temperature stays around 33 degrees C in the day and drops to 25 degrees C at night, with rain being rare and dry, sunny conditions.

sources.title: Bamboo Rafting on the Yulong River
sources.content:
Bamboo Rafting on the Yulong River

Yulong River bamboo rafting is the most favored for Yangshuo visitors, as you can appreciate the comparatively more serene countryside view and authentic life style of local residents. The Yulong River is less crowded than the Li River, which has more tourists.

You hop on a handcrafted bamboo raft and gently float on the tranquil emerald waters, immersing yourself in the soothing sounds of the flowing river and the subtle fragrance of bamboo. You'll float down to see layers of ripple, merry fishes chasing beneath the water surface, sail through hundred-year old stone bridges, and experience exciting moments passing the weirs.

The most classic route is 3 kilometers long, and within 50 minutes, you could admire the most beautiful natural sightseeing of this river. The route between Jima and Gongnong Bridge is comparatively longer, with a total experiencing length of about 6 kilometers.

The best time for rafting on Yulong River is from April to October.

sources.title: Yulong River Bamboo Rafting | ChinaGoTrip
sources.content:
Yulong River Bamboo Rafting

Admission costs 320 CNY per raft for the Jinlong Bridge - Jiuxian Village section, and 200 CNY per raft for the Shui'edi - Wanjing Pier section. Most tickets fall between 100 and 300 yuan, covering rides that last from one hour up to four hours.

Operating hours are 08:00 am - 5:00 pm.

Pregnant women, children lower than 1 meter tall, persons over 70 years old, people with heart diseases and cardio-cerebrovascular diseases are not allowed to board the bamboo raft. A valid ID card or passport is mandatory for ticket purchase.

The best time to explore the Yulong River is from April to November, when the river flows abundantly and natural landscapes are stunning.

sources.title: 遇龙河_百度百科
sources.content:
遇龙河百度百科

基本信息
遇龙河是漓江在阳朔县境内最长的支流，"全长43.5公里，流经5个乡镇，流域面积158.47平方公里"，素有"小漓江"之称。河道宽38-61米，水深0.5-2米。

地理环境
这条河流发源于临桂区白粘岭，经过金宝乡、葡萄镇、白沙镇等地，最后与金宝河汇合。河中建有多道拦河坝用于灌溉。"河道保留原始自然风貌"，呈现喀斯特地貌特征。

主要景点
古桥建筑：
- 遇龙桥（明代建造，"长约60米，宽5米，高9米"）
- 仙桂桥（"建于宋宣和五年，广西最古老的石拱桥"）
- 富里桥（"桥长30米，宽5米，高10米"）

其他景观：包括归义县遗址、旧县民居群、五指山、月亮山等近20处景致。

旅游信息
门票与时间：
- 漂流费用：全程240元/人，半程150元/人
- 开放时间：8:00-17:30

最佳季节：4月至10月最佳

交通：多数游客采用骑自行车沿河边小路，结合竹筏漂流的方式游览。

漂流路线：从朝阳码头至工农桥，沿途经过乌龟赛跑、五指峰、骆驼过江等景观。

sources.title: 桂林遇龙河漂流多少钱？不同河段的门票价格
sources.content:
遇龙河漂流门票价格

遇龙河有多个漂流路线：
- 富里桥-三岔口（2km，4人筏358元/筏）
- 金龙桥-旧县（6km，2人筏320元/筏）
- 遇龙桥-犀牛塘（2.5km，2人筏180元/筏）
- 旧县-仙桂桥（2.5km，2人筏180元/筏）
- 骥马-综合码头（6km，2人筏320元/筏）
- 水厄底-综合码头（3km，2人筏200元/筏）
- 万景和龙潭休闲漂（45元/人）

遇龙河漂流全程分为上、中、下三段：上半程（金龙桥-旧县，约2.5小时）、中段（旧县-骥马，约1.5小时）、下半程（朝阳码头-工农桥，约2小时）。

4-5月是游玩遇龙河的最佳时间，此时是丰水期且气候适宜。

购票方式：可通过遇龙河微信公众号或"i游阳朔"官方小程序购票（每日20:00放第二天的票），或在景区各码头售票处现场购买。

注意事项：1米以下儿童和70岁以上老人不能乘坐竹筏；孕妇、患有心脏病、冠心病、高血压等疾病患者严禁乘坐；漂流时要穿好救生衣。

sources.title: 阳朔遇龙河竹筏漂流多少钱_遇龙河精华段竹筏票
sources.content:
遇龙河竹筏漂流信息

遇龙河竹筏漂流起源于2001年6月，由遇龙村的打渔人应摄影师请求开始运营。若把漓江当作大家闺秀，那么遇龙河就是小家碧玉。遇龙河是桂林漓江的一条支流，河水比漓江的更为清澈，两岸可见农田农舍。

每艘竹排可以坐2个人，全程240元/人次（需选择正规公司和当地旅游局认可的竹排）。丰水期漂流全程约需2-3小时，枯水期约需3-4小时。

岸边的乡间小道只能徒步或骑自行车，单车+漂流是最享受的玩法，可在阳朔的西街租山地车。
